youtube.title: Why Milk Is Always at the Back of the Shop 🥛 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Staples such as milk, bread and eggs are usually placed at the back of the store so shoppers walk past many other products to reach them. Retailers know that shoppers make extra impulse purchases along the way. This layout strategy is widely used in grocery retail design.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
